strategicLeadership.overview: This dimension evaluates your organization's executive leadership understanding of AI, their commitment to AI transformation, and their ability to articulate and execute on a compelling AI vision that drives organizational change.

questions.text: How strong is executive leadership support for AI initiatives?

options.label: No awareness or interest from leadership
Full commitment - strategic imperative with resources

questions.text: Do you have a documented AI strategy?

options.label: Comprehensive strategy integrated with business goals

questions.text: How aligned is your AI strategy with overall business objectives?

options.label: Fully integrated - AI drives business strategy

useCasePortfolio.overview: This dimension assesses your organization's ability to identify, prioritize, and execute AI use cases that deliver tangible business value, from quick wins to transformational initiatives.

questions.text: How well have you identified and prioritized AI use cases?

options.label: Generic use cases with no prioritization
Some use cases identified and prioritized
Well-defined use cases with business cases
Portfolio of use cases with clear ROI and priorities

questions.text: How developed is your AI implementation roadmap?

options.label: Agile roadmap with regular updates and tracking

questions.text: What is your approach to scaling successful AI pilots to production?

options.label: Ad-hoc scaling attempts with limited success
Industrialized deployment pipeline with clear criteria

dataFoundation.overview: This dimension evaluates the quality, accessibility, governance, and management of your organization's data assets - the fundamental fuel for AI success.

questions.text: How would you rate the overall quality of your organizational data?

options.label: Poor quality - significant errors and inconsistencies
Below average - frequent data quality issues
Moderate - acceptable quality with some issues
Good - high quality with minor issues

questions.text: How accessible is data across your organization?

options.label: Highly siloed - data trapped in departments

questions.text: What level of data governance do you have in place?

options.label: Advanced governance with automation and monitoring

techInfrastructure.overview: This dimension assesses your organization's technological capabilities including cloud infrastructure, computing resources, platforms, and integration capabilities necessary for AI implementation.

questions.text: How would you describe your organization's cloud infrastructure maturity?

options.label: Basic cloud adoption - some workloads migrated
Hybrid cloud - mixed on-premises and cloud
Cloud-first - most workloads in the cloud

questions.text: What computational resources do you have available for AI/ML workloads?

options.label: Advanced distributed computing with AI accelerators

questions.text: How scalable is your current technology infrastructure?

options.label: Fully elastic infrastructure with automated scaling

governanceRisk.overview: This dimension examines your organization's approach to AI governance, risk management, regulatory compliance, and security measures to ensure responsible and safe AI deployment.

questions.text: How prepared are you for AI-related regulatory compliance?

options.label: Full compliance with monitoring and auditing

questions.text: What security measures are in place for AI systems?
What is your data privacy framework for AI applications?

responsibleAI.overview: This dimension evaluates your organization's commitment to ethical AI practices including fairness, transparency, accountability, and bias mitigation to ensure AI systems are developed and deployed responsibly.

questions.text: How mature is your AI ethics framework?

options.label: Aware of ethical issues but no framework

questions.text: How do you address bias and fairness in AI?

options.label: Aware of bias issues but no processes

peopleSkills.overview: This dimension assesses your organization's AI talent capabilities, skills development programs, and ability to attract, develop, and retain AI expertise across the workforce.

questions.text: What is the current level of AI skills in your organization?

options.label: Limited skills - few individuals with basic knowledge
Developing capabilities - small team building skills

questions.text: What is your investment in AI training and upskilling?

options.label: Continuous learning with certifications and academies

questions.text: How strong is your data literacy across the organization?

options.label: Data-first culture with analytics for all

changeManagement.overview: This dimension evaluates your organization's cultural readiness for AI transformation, including adaptability, learning culture, innovation mindset, and ability to manage organizational change effectively.

questions.text: How would you describe your organizational learning culture?

options.label: Resistant to change - traditional approaches preferred
Slow to adopt - cautious about new approaches

questions.text: How effective is your change management capability?

options.label: Structured change management with proven success

questions.text: How well do teams collaborate across departments on AI initiatives?

valueRealization.overview: This dimension assesses your organization's ability to measure, track, and realize tangible business value from AI investments, including ROI tracking, benefits realization, and continuous optimization.

questions.text: How do you measure success for AI initiatives?

options.label: Mix of technical and business metrics
Clear business KPIs for each initiative
Comprehensive measurement framework with ROI tracking

questions.text: What is your approach to AI business case development?

options.label: Comprehensive business cases with NPV analysis
Sophisticated value modeling with scenario analysis
